selection: Use TABULA original AAC-wall and slab-on-ground families, with independently supported period attic construction. These form a representative model, not a documented individual house.
retained_alternative: evidence/sfh_baseline_user_stacks.txt retains the former timber-wall/suspended-floor model as source material; it is a different representative family.

wall.original: 250mm AAC blocks, roughcast outside and smooth plaster inside, dated1930–1960 in source.
wall.thermal_grade: Reuse historic AAC500,lambda0.19771 W/(mK), with10mm render defaults already reviewed for MF SE.01.
wall.renovation: 45/70mm accepted facade stone wool plus22mm softwood panelling; fibre grade and panel depth are explicit EPSM defaults. All original wall layers retained.
wall.nominal_limit: Full-layer nominal R includes the panel. Ventilation/cavity corrections, battens, wind protection, support and moisture design remain project details; this is not a resolved ventilated-rainscreen calculation.

period_sources.supports: 200–300mm shavings fill including overfill above timber joists; period construction through approximately1955.
Nominal75x220mm(3x9Swedish inches),600mm centres as dimensional precedent; structural span/bearing is not verified.

attic.selection: 250mm is the midpoint of the documented range, not solved from TABULA U0.29. Existing shavingslambda0.078/density100 and timber thermal properties are unchanged. Nominal full-layer calculation does not reproduce BABS historical surface/fill corrections.
attic.renovation: Retain the original ceiling and shared200/500mm loose-glass-wool addition.
attic.interfaces: AAC bearings/ties, joist spans, air/wind control and moisture details remain project design.

ground.period_locator: BETSI Fukt och mögel2011 printedpp34–35: pre1960 slabs largely occur in1950s buildings; uninsulated slabs are documented, not asserted to be the only form.
ground.original_defaults: 160mm uninsulated concrete slab and40mm bonded cement finish. Nominal depths are EPSM choices, not recovered TABULA layers. No LECA is introduced.
ground.renovation: Warm-side EPS40/45mm atlambda0.036, retaining all original components, plus50mm nominal floating cement finish. Floor rise90/95mm.
ground.finish_scope: Generic heavyweight concrete is a thermal/carbon proxy, not a claim of exact Weber composition or performance. Moisture/vapour control, reinforcement, load distribution and clearances are project checks.
ground.u_value_scope: BETSI/TABULA0.28 is ground-effective stock information calculated using ISO13370. It cannot recover material layers; the floor comparison remains explicitly not assessed pending project geometry/soil/method.
ground.period_finish_evidence: Existing concrete-finish evidence: evidence/mf_se01_basement_floor_finish.json, SOU1944:7 printedp157 and BABS1946 printedp7. This supports the cement/concrete material family, not the SF nominal dimensions.

windows.optics: SHGC=source glazingg*(1-frame fraction0.3); VT is an explicit glazing default times0.7. No bundled external shading/angular correction.
windows.carbon: Existing modern timber/window-family Boverket proxies remain explicit; no historic manufacturing emissions or exact product identity is inferred.

validation: Checks calculate forward using unchanged source benchmarks and20% tolerance. Known full-A5 and retained-stock carbon gaps remain visible; no missing factors become zero.

separate_review_finding.finding: Manufacturer dates Swedish Leca use to the early1960s. The accepted MF nominal1943 expanded-clay recipe lacks a period-specific Swedish source and needs separate review; this does not establish the international availability date of all expanded-clay products.
separate_review_finding.action: No MF material or assembly is changed by the SF review; SF SE.01 uses no expanded clay.
